3: from __future__ import annotations

5: import numpy as np

8: def filter_api_calls(
9:     logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
10:     logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
11:     logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
12:     tau_filter: float,
13: ) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
14:     """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
15: 
16:     # Input validation
17:     if not isinstance(logp_with_result, np.ndarray) or not isinstance(logp_call_only, np.ndarray) or not isinstance(logp_no_call, np.ndarray):
18:         raise ValueError("all log probability inputs must be numpy arrays")
19:     if logp_with_result.ndim != 2 or logp_call_only.ndim != 2 or logp_no_call.ndim != 2:
20:         raise ValueError("log probability inputs must be 2D matrices")
21:     if logp_with_result.shape != logp_call_only.shape or logp_with_result.shape != logp_no_call.shape:
22:         raise ValueError("all log probability matrices must have the same shape")
23:     if logp_with_result.size == 0 or logp_with_result.shape[0] == 0 or logp_with_result.shape[1] == 0:
24:         raise ValueError("log probability matrices must not be empty")
25:     if not np.all(np.isfinite(logp_with_result)) or not np.all(np.isfinite(logp_call_only)) or not np.all(np.isfinite(logp_no_call)):
26:         raise ValueError("all log probability values must be finite")
27:     if np.any(logp_with_result > 0) or np.any(logp_call_only > 0) or np.any(logp_no_call > 0):
28:         raise ValueError("log probability values must be nonpositive")
29:     if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
30:         raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
31:     if not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
32:         raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite")
33:     if tau_filter < 0:
34:         raise ValueError("tau_filter must be nonnegative")
35:     n_candidates, horizon = logp_with_result.shape
36:     t = np.arange(horizon)
37:     raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
38:     normalized_weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()
39:     L_plus = -np.sum(normalized_weights * logp_with_result, axis=1)
40:     L_call_only = -np.sum(normalized_weights * logp_call_only, axis=1)
41:     L_no_call = -np.sum(normalized_weights * logp_no_call, axis=1)
42:     L_minus = np.minimum(L_no_call, L_call_only)
43:     margin = L_minus - L_plus
44:     keep_mask = margin >= tau_filter
45:     return keep_mask, margin
